page.overview:
Who is Mrs. Berlucchi?

Mrs. Berlucchi is a character who briefly appears in and . She is the mother of Oscar.

She is first seen at Haddonfield Memorial Hospital asking police officers and doctors where her son is. Minutes later, she discovers her son's body in the morgue.

She appears after the opening of the movie.

After the opening of Halloween Ends, while Laurie is explaining the fear Michael brought to the town, we see the police all gathering around, taking her body down after she has hanged herself (following her son's death).
